slides.title: Bootstrap Utilities Overview
slides.content:
# Bootstrap 5 Utilities & Helpers 🛠️

Bootstrap 5 features a comprehensive utility system that allows you to style layouts, spacing, typography, and borders rapidly directly inside HTML without writing custom CSS rules.

## What You'll Learn in this Module:
- **Spacing Utilities**: Margin and padding scales (`m-*`, `p-*`, `gap-*`)
- **Color & Contrast Utilities**: Text colors, subtle background tints, and borders
- **Display & Visibility**: `d-block`, `d-flex`, `d-none`, responsive visibility
- **Flexbox Utilities**: Alignment, justification, order, and grow/shrink
- **Position & Stacking**: `fixed-top`, `sticky-top`, positioning offsets
- **The Bootstrap 5 Utility API**: Customizing utilities in Sass

slides.title: Spacing Scale: Margins & Padding
slides.content:
# Spacing Utilities: Margins & Padding 📏

Bootstrap uses a 0 to 5 spacing scale based on the `$spacer` Sass variable (`1rem` / 16px default).

## The Spacing Scale

| Class Scale | CSS Value | Pixels (base 16px) |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | `0` | 0px |
| `1` | `$spacer * 0.25` | 4px |
| `2` | `$spacer * 0.5` | 8px |
| `3` | `$spacer * 1` (default) | 16px |
| `4` | `$spacer * 1.5` | 24px |
| `5` | `$spacer * 3` | 48px |
| `auto` | `margin: auto` | Auto centering |

## Property & Direction Notation

- Property: `m` (margin), `p` (padding)
- Direction: `t` (top), `b` (bottom), `s` (start/left), `e` (end/right), `x` (horizontal), `y` (vertical)
- Examples: `pt-4`, `mb-3`, `px-5`, `mx-auto`

slides.title: RTL-Friendly Directional Utilities (s & e)
slides.content:
# Modern Logical Properties: Start (`s`) & End (`e`) 🌐 In older Bootstrap versions, classes used `l` (left) and `r` (right). Bootstrap 5 uses **logical properties** for automatic Right-To-Left (RTL) language support! ## Replacement Mapping - `ps-*` (Padding Start) — Replaces `pl-*` (left in LTR, right in RTL) - `pe-*` (Padding End) — Replaces `pr-*` - `ms-*` (Margin Start) — Replaces `ml-*` - `me-*` (Margin End) — Replaces `mr-*` ```html_not

```

slides.title: Display Utilities: Block, Flex & None
slides.content:
# Display Property Utilities: `d-*` 🔲 Toggle element display types and show/hide elements responsively. ## Common Display Classes - `.d-none`: `display: none;` (hides element) - `.d-inline`: `display: inline;` - `.d-inline-block`: `display: inline-block;` - `.d-block`: `display: block;` - `.d-grid`: `display: grid;` - `.d-flex`: `display: flex;` - `.d-inline-flex`: `display: inline-flex;` ## Responsive Display Example ```html_not

slides.title: Flexbox Utilities: Direction & Justify
slides.content:
# Flexbox Utilities: Direction & Alignment 🔄

Turn any container into a flex container using `.d-flex` or `.d-inline-flex`.

## Flex Direction

- `.flex-row` (default), `.flex-row-reverse`
- `.flex-column` (stacked vertical), `.flex-column-reverse`
- Responsive: `.flex-column .flex-md-row` (stack on phone, row on tablet)

## Justify Content (Main Axis)

- `.justify-content-start`
- `.justify-content-end`
- `.justify-content-center`
- `.justify-content-between`
- `.justify-content-around`
- `.justify-content-evenly`

slides.title: Flexbox Utilities: Align Items & Grow
slides.content:
# Flexbox Cross-Axis & Child Utilities 🎯

## Align Items (Cross Axis)

- `.align-items-start`
- `.align-items-center` (vertical centering!)
- `.align-items-end`
- `.align-items-baseline`
- `.align-items-stretch`

## Flex Item Grow & Shrink

- `.flex-grow-1`: Element expands to fill remaining space
- `.flex-shrink-0`: Prevents element from squishing
- `.flex-fill`: Forces siblings to have equal widths

slides.title: Position Utilities: Fixed & Sticky
slides.content:
# Position Utilities: Fixed, Sticky & Absolute 📍

Position elements within standard document flow or lock them during scrolling.

## Common Position Classes

- `.position-static`
- `.position-relative` (sets positioning boundary for absolute children)
- `.position-absolute`
- `.position-fixed` (locks relative to browser window)
- `.position-sticky` (locks when reaching scroll threshold)

## Navigation Helpers

- `.fixed-top`: Locks navbar to top edge of browser window
- `.fixed-bottom`: Locks bar to bottom edge
- `.sticky-top`: Sticks to top when scrolled into view
- `.sticky-bottom`

slides.title: Coordinate Helpers: Top, Start, Bottom, End
slides.content:
# Coordinate Positioning Helpers 🎯

Place absolute items precisely with percentage coordinates:

| Class | CSS Value |
|---|---|
| `.top-0` | `top: 0;` |
| `.top-50` | `top: 50%;` |
| `.top-100` | `top: 100%;` |
| `.bottom-0`, `.bottom-50`, `.bottom-100` | Bottom offsets |
| `.start-0`, `.start-50`, `.start-100` | Left / Start offsets |
| `.end-0`, `.end-50`, `.end-100` | Right / End offsets |

## Centering with `.translate-middle`

Combines with `top-50 start-50` to center elements (`transform: translate(-50%, -50%)`).

slides.title: Border Utilities: Radius & Width
slides.content:
# Border Utilities 🔲

## Border Widths

- `.border`: 1px solid border on all sides
- `.border-0`: Remove border
- `.border-top`, `.border-bottom`, `.border-start`, `.border-end`
- `.border-2`, `.border-3`, `.border-4`, `.border-5`: Pixel thicknesses

## Border Radius

- `.rounded`: Soft 0.375rem corners
- `.rounded-0`: Remove corners
- `.rounded-1`, `.rounded-2`, `.rounded-3`, `.rounded-4`, `.rounded-5`
- `.rounded-circle`: Circular avatar (50%)
- `.rounded-pill`: Pill badge

Floating elevated card with rounded corners and no border!
```

slides.content: # Visibility Utilities 👁️ Control visual presentation while retaining accessibility and layout space. ## `.visible` vs `.invisible` - `.visible`: `visibility: visible;` - `.invisible`: `visibility: hidden;` — Hides element visually, but it **still takes up its physical space** in the document layout! ## `.visually-hidden` (Screen Readers Only) Hides an element visually from the screen while leaving it completely readable to screen readers and assistive devices: ```html_not ```

slides.title: Utility Best Practices
slides.content:
# Utility Best Practices 💡

1. **Combine utilities with component classes**: Use `.btn` for button structure, and add utilities like `.px-4 .py-2 .shadow-sm` for tuning.
2. **Prefer logical properties**: Use `ms-*` and `pe-*` instead of manual left/right styles.
3. **Use `.gap-*` for flex spacing**: Instead of adding margins to every child item, apply `gap-3` to the parent `.d-flex` container.

slides.title: Summary of the Bootstrap 5 Course
slides.content:
# Bootstrap 5: Complete Course Summary 🎓

Congratulations! You have mastered Bootstrap 5 from layout foundations to advanced components.

## What You Have Learned:
- **Layout & Grid**: 12-column responsive grid, containers, breakpoints (sm to xxl), gutters (`g-*`).
- **Content & Typography**: Reboot resets, headings, lead paragraphs, responsive tables, and fluid images.
- **Core Components**: Buttons, badges, cards, alerts, list groups, spinners, and progress bars.
- **Interactive Components**: Navbars, modals, carousels, accordions, offcanvas drawers, and the JS API.
- **Utilities**: Spacing (`m-*`, `p-*`), colors, display (`d-flex`), positioning, and shadows.

You are now equipped to build rapid, beautiful, mobile-friendly applications with Bootstrap 5! 🚀

slides.content:
# Next Up: Web Security Fundamentals 🛡️🔒

Now that you understand modern web design and front-end engineering, you must protect your applications against real-world vulnerabilities.

## Topics in Web Security:
- **Security Fundamentals**: CIA Triad, HTTPS/TLS, Same-Origin Policy (SOP)
- **Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)**: Stored, Reflected, DOM-based & Sanitization
- **CSRF & Clickjacking**: Anti-CSRF tokens, SameSite cookies
- **HTTP Security Headers**: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options
- **Authentication & Sessions**: Password hashing (Argon2), JWT security, MFA
- **Injection Attacks**: SQL Injection, Command Injection, Parameterized queries

Let's master Web Security! 🛡️
